item.title: Stairway to Heaven, literally
item.description: We were completely freezing yet it was still the most captivating sunset I have witnessed to date. One minute, the clouds completely consume everything around you, the next one - completely naked mountain peaks spike into the orange sky…

item.title: Edge of the World
item.description: The wind almost took me off my feet while I was taking this picture

item.title: The Island of Eternal Spring
item.description: It was pouring 30 minutes before the shot was taken, and there was a special delight in walking the levada with your shoes squishing against the wet earth

item.title: Toss A Coin To Your Witcher
item.description: If i could choose a place to get lost, it would be Fanal Forest
